turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Why am I here, Hale? A zero went on my son's essay, and nobody called me first.
Owen talks about you in class, by the way.
What does he say? And what does that have to do with the zero?
He's one of the kindest kids I teach. He walked a new student around the building all through September.
Okay. That's Owen. It doesn't tell me who decided on the zero, or why.
A kid like that doesn't cheat out of malice. He was overwhelmed. We can both agree on that, right?
No, we can't. You just said "cheat" and "overwhelmed" about my son, and you haven't shown me one thing. Owen never lies, Hale, so what have you got?
